title: Batch ref/codebook/import DB writes + set PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL
description:
Full parse of swe_dashboard = 113-128s, of which 111s is ref-resolution DB writes: resolve_file_refs (src/pipeline.rs) calls db.insert_ref (src/db/mod.rs:1236) once per ref as an autocommit transaction, and Db::open (src/db/mod.rs:424) never sets PRAGMA synchronous, so SQLite's default FULL fsyncs the WAL per commit (~1.9-2.7ms/row on btrfs/NVMe). Measured: resolver CPU 52ms vs 110,960ms writes for 40,335 refs. Same per-row pattern in save_hrr_codebook_entries (src/db/similarity.rs:102 — 5.4s for 2,628 rows) and update_import_resolved_file_id loops in dart_packages/rust_imports (~1s).

Fix: (1) collect resolved refs and write delete+insert in one transaction per file (mirror replace_file_data's existing pattern), (2) wrap codebook save in one transaction, (3) batch import-resolution updates, (4) add PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL next to journal_mode=WAL (index is rebuildable; NORMAL is the standard WAL pairing).

Microbench (home fs): FULL+autocommit 1,900us/row; NORMAL+autocommit 33us; one tx 2.3us. Expected: cold parse 113s → ~15s.

acceptance_criteria.text: Cold parse of swe_dashboard (delete ~/.sutra/swe_dashboard/index.db first) completes in well under 30s
ref resolution phase no longer dominated by DB writes
PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL set on every connection open
no per-row autocommit loops remain in resolve_file_refs, save_hrr_codebook_entries, or import resolution

execution_record: All four acceptance criteria met. PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL added to Db::open_unchecked and guard's read-only connection. save_hrr_codebook_entries wrapped in transaction. update_import_resolved_file_id replaced with batch_update_import_resolved_file_ids (single tx). Dart and Rust import resolution callers refactored to collect-then-batch. Cold parse of swe_dashboard: 120s → 9s. Codex adversarial review surfaced one gap (guard.rs bypassing open_unchecked) — fixed in follow-up commit.

messages.author: codex
messages.text: Codex review: approve with notes. One finding (low): bin/guard.rs opens index DB via Connection::open_with_flags bypassing Db::open_unchecked, missing the new PRAGMA. Read-only path so no write impact, but contract gap. Fixed in ecd6cfa.
